articles.summary: In testing, AI agents with GitLab Orbit providing a connected view of the software lifecycle completed tasks with up to 45x fewer hallucinations and up to 4.5x fewer tokens All Remote - GitLab Inc., the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps, today announced the general availability of GitLab Orbit , a context graph for the software lifecycle. GitLab Orbit connects code, merge requests, work items, pipelines, and vulnerabilities in a single, continuously updated view for AI agents and engineers. As organizations extend AI across software delivery, agents working in large codebases often lack the information they need to complete a task. Agents often spend multiple iterations gathering context and still work from partial information, producing inaccurate or incomplete answers. Each wrong answer sends the agent back to search files and repositories again, increasing token consumption and cost. With the context available in GitLab Orbit, agents complete tasks more accurately
articles.title: GitLab Orbit, Now Generally Available, Makes AI Agents More Accurate and Less Expensive to Run
